response.evidence: Analysis of 1,000 loan applications shows Asian applicants have a 95.2% approval rate (952/1000) compared to the overall dataset approval rate of ~95%. Among denied applications, Asian applicants comprise ~22% of denials despite representing ~28% of applications. Key indicators: (1) Most Asian denials involved legitimate risk factors like debt-to-income ratios >49%, high loan-to-value ratios >90%, or very low incomes; (2) Asian males specifically show slightly lower denial rates than Asian females; (3) Approval patterns across racial groups are relatively consistent when controlling for financial metrics. While your individual rejection is frustrating, the aggregate data does not reveal systematic discrimination against Asian males in this dataset.
